title: Small Business Electricity Supply Plan Schedule: Pricing Structure, Service Fee and Renewable Content
content:
Beacon Ridge Energy sells Small Business Electricity Supply under six plans. This schedule sets, for every plan, the pricing structure, the term, the flat monthly service fee per site, the introductory cycles and the renewable content that comes with the plan.

## Schedule

| Plan | Pricing structure | Term | Monthly service fee per site | Introductory rate cycles |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | variable | month-to-month (0 months) | 14.95 USD | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | fixed | 12 months | 9.95 USD | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | fixed | 24 months | 9.95 USD | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | fixed | 36 months | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | fixed | 24 months | 12.95 USD | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | fixed | 36 months | 9.95 USD | 0 |

| Plan | Renewable content beyond the state portfolio standard | Certificate retired | Annual certificate retirement statement | Window decal and logo license |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 0 percent | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | 0 percent | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | 0 percent | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | 0 percent | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | 100 percent | Green-e Energy certified national wind RECs | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | 100 percent | Green-e Energy certified PJM solar and wind RECs | yes | yes |

## Terms used in this schedule

- **Pricing structure.** A plan is either variable or fixed.
- **Term.** The length of the plan term in whole months; a term of 0 months means the plan is month-to-month.
- **Monthly service fee.** A flat supplier service fee per site, billed once per billing cycle.
- **Introductory rate cycles.** The initial billing cycles billed at the enrollment rate before monthly variable pricing applies; 0 means there are none. No plan in this schedule carries introductory cycles.
- **Renewable content.** The share of the site's usage matched with renewable energy certificates beyond the state portfolio standard, in whole percent. "None" in the certificate column means the plan carries no certificate.
- **Annual certificate retirement statement.** Whether the business receives a yearly statement of the certificates retired for it.
- **Window decal and logo license.** Whether the business receives the renewable-energy window decal and the logo license for its storefront and website.

## Reading the schedule

- The two Green plans are the only plans with renewable content, a retirement statement and the decal and logo license; they differ in the certificate retired.
- Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 is the only plan with no monthly service fee; Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable carries the highest fee.
- Hypothetical illustration: a business with three sites, each on Beacon Ridge Business Green 24, carries a monthly service fee of 12.95 USD on each site's bill every billing cycle, three fee lines in all, because the fee is set per site and per cycle.
